text:
selena-bizdev: Hey team — Orchid Health onsite demo next Tues. Need a hosted API guest credential for a live walkthrough. Requirements: 1) single key for a demo machine (chat + embeddings), 2) rate limit ~10 req/s, 3) TTL ~48h (or let me know if 24h is required), 4) IP allowlist for 3 office IPs, 5) billing tag so we can attribute usage. Also customer requests proof of audit logs and a rotation/revocation plan. Can infra create this and confirm timeline?

sam: I can provision. Pref note: hosted ephemeral keys are doable but security recommends 24h TTL. We can issue two keys (primary + standby). Send me the 3 IPs + contact email.

nate: +1 to 24h TTL for public-hosted creds. We can scope the key to chat+embed only. Do you want embeddings-only instead? That reduces blast radius.

leigh: Sales request — please add billing tag: "poc/orchid-health" so billing shows up under the pilot. Also include customer contact in the metadata.

selena-bizdev: They need chat+embed for the demo flows; will send IPs and contact now. 48h was a preference from product team but if 24h is safer we can do that and re-issue a second one mid-demo if needed.

sam: Cool. I'll create via the API and also via Console so you have both. Example API request I'll use (replace values):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"name":"poc-orchid-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":86400,"rate_limit":10,"allowlist_ips":["203.0.113.12","203.0.113.13","203.0.113.14"],"metadata":{"billing_tag":"poc/orchid-health","contact":"demoteam@orchid.example.com"}}'
```
I'll redact the admin token and paste the created key into 1Password for you.

deploy-bot: key created: hosted_key_poc_orchid_2024 (ephemeral) — created by sam — expires in 24h — scopes: chat, embeddings — rate_limit:10 req/s

selena-bizdev: awesome — please confirm where to find audit entries for creation + usage so security folks can see it.

nate: Audit logs live in Console -> Activity -> API Keys. Events: create, rotate, revoke, usage summary. We can export CSV for the security questionnaire. For hosted keys we log creation actor, IP allowlist, and metadata tags.

sam: If they want a rotation plan: 1) issue key with 24h TTL, 2) mid-demo standby key pre-created in 1Password, 3) if early revocation needed run revoke command below, 4) after demo we rotate and revoke the demo key and attach the audit export. Revoke example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_key_poc_orchid_2024/revoke \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
I'll run that if they call.

leigh: I've added the billing tag and updated the deal record with the contact.

selena-bizdev: Quick Q from the customer: "Can hosted demo keys be KMS-wrapped so we don't expose plaintext in control plane?"

nate: Short answer: hosted keys are managed in Redwood control plane and are not KMS-wrapped per-customer. For KMS/HSM-backed keys we need Private deployment or a Dedicated Private Key option (enterprise). We should mark that as an enterprise blocker in the security questionnaire and offer a short Private trial for evaluation.

selena-bizdev: Noted — I'll flag that in the RFP response. For now they'll accept short TTL + IP allowlist.

deploy-bot: key revoked: hosted_key_poc_orchid_2024 — revoked by sam — revocation_time: 1758890300

sam: Done. I revoked the key after the demo cleanup. Logged export + screenshot uploaded to the deal vault.

selena-bizdev: Thanks everyone — saved the revocation log and audit CSV. Closing loop with the customer now. :thumbsup:
